notes: The MKR 1000 WiFi is not in the catalogue, so it is a new part type. Its ports are taken from the pin labels in the diagram, plus 8 and a USB socket.
The parts list says 82 ohm, but the schematic labels the resistor 220 Ω. The images are the authority, so value=220.
In the diagram the top half of the breadboard is labelled rows j to f and the bottom half e to a. The catalogue calls rows f-j bank 'b', so all holes used are in bank 'b'.
Resistor leg 1 is in 3b.h and leg 2 is in 6b.h. The LED anode (bent, longer leg) is in 6b.j and its cathode is in 8b.j. The green wire from pin 2 ends in 3b.g. The black wire from GND ends in 8b.h.
Circuit: pin 2 -> resistor -> LED anode, LED cathode -> GND.
The sketch also calls analogRead(A1), but nothing is wired to A1. The manual describes it as a floating, random reading, so it is not part of the build.
The USB cable and computer for powering and programming are not shown in the circuit and are not included.
